sector.source: FEC bulk committee-summary files (weball26 candidates + webk26 PACs/parties), latest snapshot
sector.dedupMethod: EXACT netting from FEC bulk committee-summary files (weball26 candidates + webk26 PACs/parties): gross receipts minus all committee-to-committee inflows (transfers + inter-committee contributions). Supersedes the earlier 0.616 ratio estimate, which invalidly compared FEC receipts to OpenSecrets cost-of-election.
sector.raisedVsCostNote: This is money RAISED (de-duplicated), not money SPENT on campaigns. OpenSecrets cost-of-election (2022 $8.9B, 2024 $15.9B) measures election spending and is a different, smaller metric.
